CustomField.description: Rich text shown in this section. For Display Text sections it is the whole body; for other section types it appears as intro text above the form. Merge fields such as {{FirstName}} resolve against the live Form Submission, so they update as the respondent types. Message Variant can style it as a status card.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Rich text shown in this section: it is the body of a Display Text section, or intro copy above the form for other types. You can use merge fields that read from the form's values, and pair it with Message Variant to style it as an info, warning, error, or success card.
CustomField.label: Section Text
